cohort: 61 pregnant women with CD and established perianal disease, and 61 non-pregnant women with CD and perianal disease
finding: There was no difference in the risk of symptomatic perianal flares after delivery in women with established perianal CD who delivered vaginally or by cesarean section.
mod_finding: No difference in rates of perianal surgical intervention or luminal disease flares was observed based on mode of delivery.
